translations.text: And we remember before God the Father the works of your faith, the labor of your love, and the endurance of your hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
For the word of our Lord has been heard from you, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has been heard of everywhere, so that we have no need to say anything about you.
For our Lord himself will descend from heaven with a command, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.
When they say, “There is peace and safety,” then destruction will suddenly come upon them, like labor pains upon a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
I put you under oath by our Lord to have this letter read to all the holy brothers.
